question: Which ordering correctly ranks the years by average positive ratings per game, highest to lowest? (A) 2012, 2013, 2011, 2010, 2015, 2014, 2016, 2017, 2018 (B) 2012, 2011, 2013, 2010, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018 (C) 2018, 2017, 2016, 2015, 2014, 2013, 2012, 2011, 2010. Answer with just the letter.
